author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.1 - Remote sensors now also show their 'time since last motion/occupancy' in a human-readable form (timeSinceMotion / timeSinceOccupancy, e.g. '3h 50m' or '13d 4h'), so you can read a sensor's activity age at a glance — handy for spotting a stale or offline sensor. The original numeric seconds values remain for use in rules. (0.19.0 - Stopped the log filling up with 'HAP: no update in Ns — reconnecting' on an idle thermostat: added a configurable Live-session safety-reconnect window, default 6 minutes, and demoted that routine message from warning to info. After updating, open the thermostat device once and click Save Preferences.)
tags: Thermostat, ecobee, HomeKit, HAP, Local, Sensor

drivers.name: Ecobee HAP Thermostat
drivers.description: Local controller for an ecobee thermostat over the HomeKit Accessory Protocol (HAP): mode, setpoints, temperature, humidity, operating state, and fan.

drivers.name: Ecobee HAP Remote Sensor
drivers.description: Child device for ecobee remote sensors (temperature, occupancy, motion, battery). Created automatically by the thermostat driver.
